westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring hand-placed pixel clusters, a limited 32-color palette, dithering for shadows, and charmingly chunky character proportions. Fluid 2D sprite animation aesthetic, high-contrast pixel art.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Rankin/Bass Stop Motion
westernAnimationStyles.pre: Rankin/Bass Holiday Stop Motion style animation.
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring soft retro fantasy styling, painted charm, and a muted television palette. Vintage fantasy-cartoon aesthetic. Captured with the look of a Ektachrome E100 film

westernAnimationStyles.label: Retro Video Game Cinematic
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring low-polygon geometry with low-quality baked texture maps, slight jagged edges (aliasing), fixed-camera composition, and bloom-heavy lighting. Early cinematic 3D gaming aesthetic.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Rubberhose video game style
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring inked outlines, aged cel colors, and a 1930s rubber-hose design language. Retro game-cartoon aesthetic.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Soviet Animation Style
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring textured backgrounds, simple character design and unusual color palettes, and surreal illustrative styling. Vintage Eastern-European Soviet Era aesthetic.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Stop-Motion Paper Collage style.
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring layered matte paper shapes, handcrafted graphic construction, and tactile depth. Collage-like silhouette aesthetic.

westernAnimationStyles.label: TMNT Classic
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring thick black outlines, bright flat cel palettes, simple colors, simple lineart and expressive TV-cartoon faces. VHS Low Quality, 1980s Saturday morning cartoon aesthetic.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Transforming Robots
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring thin black outlines, Simple colors, simple line art, sharp geometric cel-shading, 1984 Takara-inspired design, 1980s Saturday morning cartoon aesthetic, VHS capture, noise grain effect.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Trnka Puppet-Animation style.
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring folk-art textures, sculpted forms, and uncanny handcrafted surfaces. Surreal handmade-puppet aesthetic.

westernAnimationStyles.label: Underwater Comedy Animation
westernAnimationStyles.pre: United Plankton / Stephen Hillenburg Aesthetic animation.
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring thick, slightly wobbly ink outlines, characters are simple flat color with vibrant tropical saturated colors, and hand-painted "flower sky" backgrounds with watercolor textures. Distorted, rubbery facial expressions with a lo-fi charm.

westernAnimationStyles.label: UPA Hubley Style
westernAnimationStyles.post: Featuring flat design, thick simple outlines for characters, minimal mid-century geometry, and restrained color blocks. Modernist graphic aesthetic.
